translated_seed.interpretation: The special shell is recovered around the translated seed center, not around an arbitrary fixed origin.

superposition.interpretation: Velocity composition is linear and remains divergence-free, but the pressure/advection closure source Q contains a nonzero cross term. Static composition therefore does not imply dynamical independence.

proof_boundary: Finite translated/superposed benchmarks establish covariance and a cross-coupling witness only; they do not cover arbitrary initial data.
